Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649955. Filter to rows where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno, and join assays on assay_id. Filter assays by chembl_id CHEMBL4649955. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
